doc.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009

title: Business lessons of the Europe trip
summary: Organizing the trip was like business school.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe

blocks.x: remembers those things, but they know very little about the work-up to it. I said, “Wow, we’re going to Europe and this is when we leave” and all of that, but they had no idea about the contracts and the stuff like that. So that’s an aspect that, as I said, it was like going to business school.
